name: prompt-to-icon-pack
description: Generate, split, QA, vectorize, and export coherent visual asset packs from one prompt or character reference.

interface.shortDescription: One prompt or IP image into a QA-ready visual asset pack.
interface.longDescription: Generate coherent icons, emoji, stickers, avatars, badges, and sprites in style-anchored sheets; split irregular layouts, preserve internal white details, remove exterior backgrounds, name assets, run closed-loop QA, vectorize eligible artwork, and export production packages.
defaultPrompt: Create a coherent 24-icon product asset pack from my brief.
Turn my character reference into 24 transparent reaction stickers.
Split, vectorize, and export this visual asset sheet.
